So, what is this show? Each episode, I pick one report from the imitator site and turn it into something you can follow on your commute or while doing the dishes. The scripts are checked against the original report. And if I can't find a source for something, I don't say it. And every episode is heard by a real person, start to finish before it goes out. No unchecked hacks here. We'll talk code, we'll talk agents, and we'll talk about keeping your own head in shape while AI rewrites everything around us. At the end of every episode, I'll set a break point, and we'll stop and pick up three things to take with you. Links to the original reports, which are in Chinese, are in the show notes. Okay, leave one small light on, grab a glass of water. If you're getting this, send me a pong. See you next time.
